info.title: PoYo AI - Ideogram Vector 1.0 API
info.description: Generate SVG vector graphics from a prompt, with up to five reference images, or convert one image into an SVG.

text-to-vector.summary: Generate an SVG from a prompt

input.prompt: A playful cat logo with bold outlines and flat colors

text-with-references.summary: Generate an SVG with reference images

image-to-vector.summary: Convert one image into an SVG

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer PoYo_API_KEY
```

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for finished or failed task notifications.

input.description: Text to vector requires prompt. Image conversion requires one image URL. Reference images belong in reference_image_urls and do not select image conversion.

prompt.description: Required for text to vector. Describe the SVG in 1-9500 characters containing non-whitespace text. Do not send this field when image_urls is set.

image_urls.description: Image conversion only. Supply exactly one publicly accessible HTTP(S) image URL. JPEG, PNG, or WebP, up to 50 MB. A non-empty array converts that image and rejects prompt, reference images, quality, count, and size.

reference_image_urls.description: Text to vector only. Supply 1-5 publicly accessible HTTP(S) reference images. The first URL is the primary reference. JPEG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MB each. This field does not select image conversion.

quality.description: Text to vector quality. Defaults to medium. Not accepted for image conversion.

n.description: Text to vector output count, from 1 through 8. Defaults to 1. Not accepted for image conversion.

size.description: Text to vector aspect ratio. Defaults to auto. Not accepted for image conversion.

mode.description: Image conversion only. default keeps finer detail. simple uses fewer shapes. Defaults to default. Not accepted for text to vector.

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`
